t: As you lie down for the night
a: ثُمَّ لْيَقُلْ بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي فَإِنْ أَحْيَيْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا
p: Bismika rabbī waḍaʿtu janbī, fa-in aḥyayta nafsī fa-rḥamhā, wa in amattahā fa-ghfir lahā.
m: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side. If You take my soul, have mercy on it; and if You send it back, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.
